story_overview: At the Black Rook Gallery, a surveillance team comprised of Leo, Dante, and Nate monitors photographer Chloe. As Chloe interacts with other attendees like Marcus and Simon, the team gathers data from their van and analyzes it back at their high-tech Analysis Center, focusing on gait analysis to uncover a hidden plot.

Marcus: Man with dark hair wearing a grey suit, a white collared shirt, and a red patterned tie.
Leo: Man wearing the Surveillance Team's grey suit and a red tie.
The Black Rook Gallery: Modern art gallery and chess tournament hall interior featuring large black sculptures.
the giant chess sculpture: Giant black chess piece sculpture.

In The Black Rook Gallery, Leo, wearing the surveillance team uniform, stands and talks to Chloe and Marcus. Chloe, wearing the pink beret, stands with her back to the camera, nodding as she listens.
